nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: Investigator detected. One fatality has been reported in the mining sector. I can provide access to available station records. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: The engine room is a restricted area. Personnel records contain the latest recorded entry and exit times. Compare those records with the estimated time of death.

nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: Clearance status is recorded in the personnel database. Clearance alone does not prove that an employee entered the room. Verify the timestamps before drawing a conclusion.

nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: The incident report is incomplete. I cannot reliably identify a motive from the currently available personnel records. You should establish the timeline first.

nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: Investigative suggestion: sort personnel by their last recorded engine room entry. Check who was present near the relevant time, then compare entry and exit times. Do not assume that the last person recorded is automatically responsible.

nodes.speaker: YPSILON STATION AI
nodes.text: Session terminated. Remember: recorded access is evidence, not proof of guilt.
